layerGroup.name: MaC_3-15_SRW_tracking
layerGroup.title: Interpolated tracking movements of Southern right whales from State Space Modelling (NESP MaC 3.16)
layerGroup.abstractTxt: This map package shows the interpolated positions of four southern right whales satellite tagged in Encounter Bay, SA in June 2024. Locations are predicted at six-hour intervals using a state-space model, together with dive metrics summarised for the three hours before and after each modelled location.
